assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a high resolution professional raster HUD FRAME ASSET SHEET for a woodland arena shooter. Transparent alpha background, transparent hollow interiors. Exactly 24 blank frame assets in a strictly aligned 8 ROW by 3 COLUMN grid. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no icons, no background scene, no baked checkerboard. All frames are face-on screen-space graphics with parallel edges, no perspective. Large landscape canvas ideally 2400x1800. Generous gaps, no overlapping, no clipping. SAME structural designs repeat across all eight rows, only accent colors change.
COLUMNS left to right: (1) wide shallow top-center status frame aspect 7:1 with two thin vertical dividers for three content fields; (2) bottom-center capacity/resource frame aspect 5:1 with thin empty progress track near lower inside edge; (3) right-side objective card frame aspect 4:1 with two-line free content area and empty fine progress track at bottom. Each column fixed width, all rows aligned.
ROWS top to bottom MUST follow these eight distinct existing game palettes:
1 NEUTRAL silver-grey: shadow #394a50, middle #819796, highlight #c7cfcc.
2 GOLD main objective/armor: shadow #884b2b, middle #de9e41, highlight #e8c170.
3 BRONZE construction capacity: shadow #7a4841, middle #be772b, highlight #e8c170. Clearly warmer darker browner than gold.
4 BLUE secondary objective: shadow #3c5e8b, middle #4f8fba, highlight #73bed3.
5 PURPLE encounter: shadow #402751, middle #a23e8c, highlight #c65197 with small #df84a5 highlights. Magenta purple, not blue.
6 GREEN completed/success: shadow #25562e, middle #75a743, highlight #a8ca58.
7 ORANGE utility: shadow #8a4018, middle #d97030, highlight #f0a048.
8 RED ultimate/failure: shadow #752438, middle #a53030, highlight #cf573c. Clearly red, not orange.
Shared dark neutral structural base #151d28 and #10141f throughout. Each entire frame must visibly carry its row color along fine edge trims and corner accents; distinct colored variants, not just a tiny colored dot. Refined hand-painted game art texture, crisp silhouettes, narrow rails, restrained ornaments confined to outer corners; keep centers empty for later text. No glow clouds, no excessive jewels, no huge ornaments. This is one cohesive set with 8 colorways and 3 functional shapes per colorway.
STYLE: dark carved wood with elegantly incised leaf relief corner caps and colored enamel inlay along slender rounded rectangular rails. Organic forest craftsmanship, sparse small leaf shapes carved into the structure, no sprawling vines. Warm hand-painted tactile details. Color accents dominate enough to clearly distinguish all eight rows.
